verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a web API for managing organizations, teams, and data export, plus an OpenAPI schema for the /api/0/ surface. None of it documents creating or provisioning dashboards or alert rules through the API, JSON models, or Terraform. Dashboards and alerts are documented only as UI product features, so as-code provisioning is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
